summary: But back to the issues of coaching versus curriculum, I think we need to watch the space. The edreformnorati have given up on teacher evaluation being the great savior of schools and now have set sight on curriculum as captain of change.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: But back to the issues of coaching versus curriculum, I think we need to watch the space. The edreformnorati have given up on teacher evaluation being the great savior of schools and now have set sight on curriculum as captain of change.
